## Navbar.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `brand` :: The mark or title at the start of the bar.
- `children` :: The primary links, usually `NavbarLink`s.
- `actions` :: Trailing actions — a search, an account menu, a sign-in button.
- `sticky` :: Pins the bar to the top of the viewport as the page scrolls.
- `glassOnScroll` :: Adds a glass surface once the page has been scrolled.
- `label` :: Accessible name of the navigation.
- `menuLabel` :: Accessible name of the small-screen menu button.
- `menuSurface` :: The surface of the menu sheet that opens on a small screen.
- `menuMeasure` :: The width of the sheet, drawn only as wide as a short menu needs.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the menu button and of the sheet.

## NavbarLink.svelte

### `interface Props`

- `href` :: The destination of the link.
- `current` :: Marks this link as the current page.
- `textColor` :: The ink of a link that is not the current page.
- `children` :: The link label.
